entries.notes: H 栏疑裴/裳，据 M 音写与 L「portada o puerta」推为扉（门扇）之形近异写

entries.zh: 裱，装裱、裱糊（书画装裱、裱贴封面门面）；表
entries.en: to mount or paste (a scroll, cover or frontispiece)
entries.notes: H 栏疑裱/表且 M 声调标记 T99 污损难辨，与 portada 对应关系不明，暂按裱糊装裱解
H 栏疑閤/闊，据 L ancha（宽）与 M 首音节为门，取门阔（宽门）义
门字后口字重出（M 栏音写亦两见口），当为门口之重复誊写，义即门口

entries.zh: 门楣，门框上方的横木；门头
entries.en: door lintel, horizontal beam above a doorway
entries.notes: H 栏疑楣/裱，M 音写支持楣字，取门楣（门上横木）义

entries.zh: 牌楼，牌坊；教堂前庭入口的牌坊式门楼
entries.en: ceremonial memorial archway; gateway at the entrance of a church compound or atrium (compás)
entries.notes: L 栏截断残缺（「o port tal-」疑为 portal 残文），据 H/M 牌楼互证定牌楼义；compás 指教堂前庭

entries.zh: 三川门，三门（中门与两侧门共三道的门面，多指庙宇门楼）
entries.en: triple gate; façade with three doorways (central door flanked by two side doors)

entries.zh: 华表，华表柱（宫殿、陵墓、桥梁前雕饰华美的石柱）；华美的装饰门柱
entries.en: ornamental carved column erected before palaces, tombs or bridges; richly decorated pillar
entries.notes: L hermosayrica 为 hermosa y rica 之连写（华美富丽），印证华表之华饰义

entries.zh: 碑坊，牌坊（旌表功德贞节的石坊门）；华美的坊门
entries.en: memorial archway, stone gateway commemorating merit or virtue; ornate gateway

entries.zh: 看门人，守门人，门房；把守门户的人
entries.notes: L 栏疑 Portero/Portillo，据 H 把门人取 Portero（门丁）义

entries.zh: 看门，看守门户；照看门房
entries.en: to watch or keep the door; to keep gate
entries.notes: L 头词「por few」难辨（疑讹写），据 H 看门取看守门户义

entries.zh: 管门，掌管门户；看管大门
entries.en: to have charge of the door; to keep/tend the gate
entries.notes: L 头词同上难辨，据 H 管门取掌管门户义

entries.zh: 守门，守卫门户；把守大门
entries.en: to guard the door or gate
entries.notes: L 头词同上难辨，据 H 守门取守卫门户义

entries.zh: 墙隙，墙上的缺口或裂缝；墙洞、小门洞
entries.en: gap or crevice in a wall; small opening in a wall
entries.notes: R 栏残缺且 H 栏疑牆/撞，据 M 栏音写与 L portillo（墙上小洞口；byano 疑为 vano，洞口）取墙隙义
四栏仅残迹或空白，无从立义

entries.en: (of a bird) to alight and rest; to rest
entries.notes: L Potarse 当为 posarse 之形误，M 栏两音写与息对应不明，据 H 息与鸟栖语境释义

entries.en: (of a bird) to roost for the night; to lodge overnight
entries.notes: M 栏音写难与宿字直对（疑长体 s 误读），据 H 宿与 L posarse la ave（鸟栖落）释义

entries.en: to lodge for the night, put up at an inn
entries.notes: H 投宿与 L posar（住宿）相合，但 M 末音写与宿不合且 L 语境作鸟栖，故降为 medium 取投宿义
